source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 January 1928, p. 7 ("The Belfast results: Socialists lose one seat and gain another"); Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1928, p. 7 ("Eight unopposed returns")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes, valid votes, spoiled votes and electorate from the News-Letter's ward results (INA OCR); * = retiring member as printed; where the OCR of a vote is garbled the figure used is the one that agrees with both the printed valid votes and the printed majority; full names and labels from the News-Letter's list of nominations

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), with a second Ormeau seat vacant through the resignation of George Stewart; nominations 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1928. Six wards were contested; the rest returned their members unopposed once Albert Edgar withdrew in Ormeau (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1928).
